violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. There was no CFM at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. Observed cooked chicken in WIC cooling for 3 hours at a temperature of 73f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Item discarded.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: bean sprouts in #3 at 50f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Item discarded.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: recently prepared summer rolls (53F, out temperture control) stored on shelf above Avantico 2 Dr preptop refrigerator and metal container of cut romaine lettuce leaves (49F, out of room temperature control) stored on prep counter on prepline.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated summer rolls and container of cut romaine lettuce leaves to walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F or below.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple plastic squeeze bottles (water, sauces, oil, vinegar, etc.) and plastic containers of toppings (fried onions and crushed red peppers and seasonings.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed to label on food items removed from original container and not easily identifiable. PHO 7 (Inspection Date: 09/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Box of food stored on the floor inside the walk in freezer and bulk container of ramen broth stored on floor inside the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated box of food to shelf inside walk in freezer and bulk container of ramen broth to a shelf inside the walk-in refrigerator.

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to dust or other contamination as follows: multiple (over 30) glasses of premade water cups stored uncovered for uncertain timeframe on shelf behind cash register in front area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. EHS instructed CFM to limit number of premade water cups to when needed and avoid water cups being uncovered/ unprotected for uncertain timeframe.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: bowl (no handle) used as scoop stored in container of standing water (78F) next to the rice warmer on the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM discarded the container of standing water and will discontinue using the bowl as a scoop for rice.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS texted CFM copy of the written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chlorine sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CDI: CFM agreed to discontinue using the chlorine dishmachine machine until repaired and chlorine sanitizer solution is between 100- 200ppm per manufacture instructions. CFM agreed to use the 3 vat sink to wash, rinse, and sanitize (using bleach/ chlorine) kitchen equipment until chlorine dish machine is repaired.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked sliced beef (47F) stored in overcrowded metal container in the top part of the 2 Dr Avantico preptop refrigerator on the prep line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM removed half portion of the cooked sliced beef from the metal container and reloated to the Norlake walk in refrigerator. The middle portion of the cooked sliced beef temperature was 41F at time of inspection and remained stored in top part of the 2 Dr Avantico preptop refrigerator.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: fully cooked chicken wings pulled from the freezer and thawed and housemade pre-rolled chicken egg rolls stored inside the Norlake walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM added date marked label to the cooked chicken wings (remaining 5-day hold) and the house made pre-rolled chicken egg rolls (remaining 6-day hold) with the remaining 7-day hold.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed multiple boxes of food stored on the floor inside the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated boxes of food to shelf inside the walk in freezer.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEES WASH HANDS DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES WITH STAFF. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND THAT ALL STAFF ARE PROPERLY TRAINED ON HANDWASHING PROCEDURES BY FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE RINSE OFF HANDS AT FOOD PREP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS AT HANDWASHING SINK. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED ON PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employees was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CUTTING CARROTS WITH BARE HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED OF CARROTS. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED ON PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES AND GLOVES ARE WORN WHEN HANDLING READY-TO-EAT FOODS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink NEAR BEVERAGE PREPARATION AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED PAPER TOWELS TO SINK DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED NO SIGNAGE POSTED AT HANDWASHING SINK NEAR BEVERAGE PREPARATION AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SIGNAGE SHOULD BE POSTED AT HANDWASHING SINK. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED.

violations.title: Receiving Temperature, Refrigerated Foods
violations.observation: The following refrigerated food items were received at inadequate temperatures: OBSERVED BEAN SPROUTS BETWEEN 50-70F.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated time/temperature control for safety food shall be at a temperature of 41F or below when received. PIC DISCARDED OF BEAN SPROUTS. PIC UNDERSTANDS RECEIVING TEMPERATURES OF TCS FOODS SHOULD BE TAKEN AND FOODS OUT OF TEMPERATURE SHOULD NOT BE ACCEPTED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW PORK STORED OVER CUT AND READY-TO-EAT VEGETABLES IN THE FRONT 2-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION AND EHS DISCUSSED PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED PARTIALLY COOKED CHICKEN IN FRONT 2-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. PIC UNDERSTANDS NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS IS NOT PERMITTED UNLESS WRITTEN PLANS/PROCEDURES ARE SUBMITTED TO AND APPROVED BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT. PIC AGREED TO DISCONTINUE PROCESS. PLEASE ENSURE NO RAW MEATS ARE COOKED WITH A NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS. PHO 7 (Inspection Date: 09/23/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED BEEF COOKED THE NIGHT PRIOR TO INSPECTION AT 50F IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF BEEF DURING INSPECTION. PROPER COOLING METHODS WERE DISCUSSED WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: NO DATE MARKING SYSTEM OBSERVED IN PLACE FOR ANY COOKED OR PREPARED FOODS (SUCH AS COOKED CHICKEN, BEEF, SOUP, VEGETABLES, ETC.) OR ANY FOODS THAT WERE PULLED FROM THE FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED DATE MARKING SYSTEM WITH PIC. PIC UNDERSTANDS DATE MARKING SYSTEM SHOULD BE IN PLACE BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. PHO 7 (Inspection Date: 09/23/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED NO CONSUMER ADVISORY IN PLACE FOR ROUND-EYE STEAK.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PIC UNDERSTANDS CONSUMER ADVISORY SHOULD BE ADDED TO THE MENU BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. .

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN THAWING AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER THAWING METHODS WITH PIC. PIC MOVED RAW CHICKEN TO WALK-IN COOLER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS SPICES/OILS NOT IN THEIR ORIGINAL CONTAINER WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE ALL WORKING BOTTLES/CONTAINERS HAVE A LABEL BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: OBSERVED SOME DRAIN FLIES IN MOP SINK AREA, BAR HANDWASHING SINK, AND WOMEN’S BATHROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE ENSURE PEST CONTROL SERVICES THE ESTABLISHMENT PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED ONIONS STORED ON THE FLOOR IN BACK KITCHEN AND FOOD STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN WALK-IN COOLER AND FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS SHOULD BE ELEVATED BY TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER JEWELRY ATTIRE WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION. PHO 7 (Inspection Date: 09/23/2025) Page 4 of 5

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER STORAGE OF WIPING CLOTHS WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED CUPS WITHOUT HANDLES STORED IN VARIOUS BULK FOOD ITEMS; OBSERVED KNIFE STORED BETWEEN TABLE AND PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: OBSERVED NON-NSF APPROVED BUCKETS AND BULK CONTAINERS USED TO STORE VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE CONTAINERS MAY NOT BE USED TO STORE FOOD ITEMS AS THEY ARE NOT FOOD-GRADE/SAFE. PLEASE GRADUALLY REPLACE THESE WITH NSF-APPROVED CONTAINERS AND DISCONTINUE USE BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED CARDBOARD AND ALUMINUM FOIL LINING VARIOUS SHELVES AND FLOORS THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC UNDERSTANDS CARDBOARD AND FOIL SHOULD NOT BE USED TO LINE ANY SHELVES/FLOORS AS THEY ARE NOT DURABLE. PIC REMOVED CARDBOARD AND FOIL DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED EQUIPMENT AT THE GRILL-LINE (STOVE BURNERS, FRYERS, ETC.) AND SHELVES AND FAN VENT IN WALK-IN COOLER IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE ENSURE THESE AREAS ARE CLEANED THOROUGHLY BY THE TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the WALLS/FLOORS THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN in the is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE ENSURE WALLS/FLOORS ARE CLEANED THOROUGHLY PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: OBSERVED LIGHT MISSING A SHIELD IN THE BACK KITCHEN NEAR MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. PLEASE ENSURE A SHIELD IS INSTALLED FOR THIS LIGHT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: lettuce (66f) and pickled carrots (69f) observed on countertop in double bin with melted ice.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC replaced the ice to allow the food to cool. Ice should fully surround the sides food storage containers when being used as a coolant. Ice shall be replaced at a frequency sufficient to maintain cold holding temperatures at 41F or below.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons at the server counter were not stored with the handles up.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided.
